thread:
jenna: looping in @arun and @carla to finish the handoff for the GCP starter-iac labs. ready to transfer the terraform + deploy-runbook today?

mike: yep from our side. repo is stable, tests passing. quick checklist in the repo README.

arun (GCP SI): thanks — can you confirm which artifacts we should publish to the partner bucket vs. leave in the repo? need to coordinate with our security team.

jenna: good call. publish these to the partner bucket: tf modules (v1.0.0), example manifests for marketplace listing, and the prebuilt GCE images. keep the CI pipeline and sample apps in the repo only.

lisa: FYI the marketplace metadata needs the runtime constraints (min vCPU, quantization note). I added a short field in marketplace/metadata.yaml.

carla (partner-ps): received. we'll run an initial deploy in our sandbox next week. low-friction ask: include a small quickstart script to wire service-account and KMS keys.

jenna: yes — there's a helper script at scripts/gcp-quickstart.sh, and a sample IAM policy in configs/iam-example.json. snippet: ```
# sample quickstart usage
./scripts/gcp-quickstart.sh --project my-proj --sa redwood-iac-sa
terraform -chdir=examples/marketplace init
terraform -chdir=examples/marketplace apply -var-file=secrets.tfvars
```

arun (GCP SI): perfect. two questions: 1) which terraform providers and required versions? 2) do we have a small e2e test that verifies listing + deploy flows?

mike: providers: google = ">= 4.0", google-beta optional for some APIs, registry module uses "hashicorp/google". pinned provider versions are in providers.tf. e2e: yes, tests/ci/e2e runs a smoke deploy against a throwaway project and tears down. it uses a cached image to speed up.

carla (partner-ps): timeline: we want to run the sandbox deploy Mon/Tue, then a joint runbook review Wed. can you share the runbook doc URL and the module version we should pin?

jenna: runbook is https://docs.redwood.com/partner/gcp-starterkit-runbook (internal link). recommended module tag: v1.0.0-rc2 for the handoff; we'll promote after your smoke tests.

lisa: small note — add a README snippet about resource quotas and recommended machine types (n2-standard-8 or a2-highgpu for perf testing). I've pushed that to docs/perf-guidance.md.

arun (GCP SI): noted. I'll validate quotas with infra team before Mon. can someone add a short troubleshooting checklist for the common IAM errors we ran into?

mike: adding now — will include the IAM diffs, common error messages, and expected policies. pushing to docs/troubleshooting.md in a minute.

gcp-onboarding-bot: scheduled sandbox deploy for carla (partner-ps) on 1805080000 to run e2e smoke test. Please ensure CI tokens are rotated before that job.

carla (partner-ps): thanks. final ask: can Redwood provide a tiny sample notebook (Colab or Vertex) that calls the hosted API and a local example that uses the dedicated endpoint? helps our PS engineers verify latency/cost quickly.

jenna: yes — adding a small Colab and a Vertex notebook to examples/notebooks. will include dedicated endpoint sample with auth snippet.

arun (GCP SI): great — after the sandbox run we'll schedule the joint announcement plan meeting. for that meeting, we'll need the short one-pager describing expected customer patterns and the recommended marketplace SKU.

jenna: I'll draft the one-pager and drop it in docs/partner-announcements.md by Tue morning. action items: 1) mike: finish troubleshooting doc (today). 2) jenna: post one-pager & notebooks (Tue AM). 3) carla/arun: run sandbox deploy (Mon/Tue) and feedback. 4) mike/carol: rotate CI tokens before scheduled e2e.

carla (partner-ps): all set from my side. thanks folks :tada:

mike: on it. ping if anything blocks. :thumbsup:

jenna: thanks team, we'll reconvene after the smoke test and lock the module tag for marketplace publish.
